purpose: Teach: 寅次郎/ハーバード/義経/薩摩/アムステルダム/カタルーニャ/諏訪/福山

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん父さん、寅次郎ファンだったな
lines.en: Riku, your dad's a Tora-san fan, isn't he?
lines.style: Casual, testing observation. Slight lift at the end—inviting him to confirm or push back. Familiar teen shorthand, not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ハーバード大学志望だな、桜
lines.en: You're thinking Harvard, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet pivot—turning her observation back on her. Not accusatory, just noticing. Slight smile underneath. The tone of someone checking if she's really committed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で源義経習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you studied Minamoto no Yoshitsune in history, right?
lines.style: Direct question, but softer than it looks. She's building to something. Waiting for his answer before the next move. Easy pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で薩摩旅行行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went to Satsuma that one time, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her move. Quiet acknowledgment—he knows, he was paying attention. Slight turn inward on the memory. Not quite meeting her eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アムステルダム留学夢だったな
lines.en: Riku, you used to dream about studying abroad in Amsterdam, didn't you?
lines.style: Softer now. Less testing, more remembering. She's invoking something he told her once. Gentle accountability—you said this, I listened.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でカタルーニャ習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Catalonia in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter still. Meeting her halfway. He's showing he was listening too. Small breath before her name—tenderness disguised as factual recall.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で諏訪湖行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you went to Lake Suwa with your family.
lines.style: Not quite a question anymore. Statement of fact, but weighted. She's naming something she knows. Slight pause before his name, like she's offering something back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、福山雅治のドラマ全部観てたな、桜
lines.en: You watched every single Masaharu Fukuyama drama, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warmth breaking through. Almost a confession—he noticed everything. Small, close-range honesty. The kind of thing you'd never admit unless you were sure it was safe.
